high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a Microsoft Excel spreadsheet. The spreadsheet has a green background with a grid layout. In the cells, there are alternating shades of purple and pink, creating a pattern that resembles a bar chart or a series of blocks. The Excel interface is visible at the top, showing various tabs such as "Draw," "Page Layout," "Formulas," "Data," "Review," "View," "Automate," and "Help." There are also icons for font formatting, alignment, number formatting, conditional formatting, and cell styles. The text at the top of the image reads: "1 day ago 40
